task.description: Independently validate test/specs/REQ-052.md and test/letflow/engine_cancel_instance_test.exs against REQ-052's 7 acceptance criteria. Read the files directly, not TEST-DESIGNER's summary. Specifically check: (1) every AC has a runnable test that would fail if violated, (2) no TODO/skip left, (3) test fixtures use per-test unique data, (4) tests are self-sufficient (no inter-test ordering dependency), (5) no hardcoded secrets, (6) MANDATORY per docs/anti-patterns.md's recurring defect: mechanically check every describe+test combined name length is under ExUnit's 255-char hard cap (grep/measure, don't eyeball) -- this exact class of defect has broken full-file compilation 4 times on this project.
acceptance_criteria: At least one runnable test targets each of REQ-052's 7 acceptance criteria
No TODO: implement test left in the spec
Test fixtures use per-test unique data, no cross-test pollution
Tests are self-sufficient, no ordering dependency
Every describe+test combined name is mechanically verified under 255 chars (255 hard cap, 200 is the project's own guidance margin)

result.summary: All 7 ACs have >=1 runnable test (AC2 has 3 sub-tests); no TODO/skip in spec or test file; fixtures are per-test unique (own tenant/schema via insert_tenant!/0 + System.unique_integer, unique_name/1, unique_idempotency_key/1); no setup/setup_all block, each test self-provisions -- no ordering dependency; no hardcoded secrets/connection strings. Mechanical describe+test combined-name-length check (script, not eyeballed) over all 9 tests in test/letflow/engine_cancel_instance_test.exs: lengths 138,170,165,156,142,131,156,131,161 chars -- max 170, under the 255 hard cap and the 200-char project guidance margin.
